name: coordinator-planned-anchoring
body:
Anchoring note for the session coordinator. `solution.container.mutation-coordinator` and its components (`session-routing`, `session-lifecycle`, `derived-projection-buffer`) are NOT yet built, so they carry no `implemented-by` edges — the plan-writer declares their real code FQNs as planned Implementation nodes (`apg plan add <project> planned …`) and the spine is wired to those at plan/reconciliation time. Only `solution.component.mutation-db-decoupling` is anchored today: `apg.artifacts.code_universes`, `apg.artifacts.reingest_layers`, `apg.git.reanchor_scan_meta`, and `apg.layers.write_project` resolve in the scanned graph as the DB-opening code this component must reshape.

The coordinator is a MANDATORY deliverable, not a plan option (session-mutation-coordinator): the plan MUST realize the coordinator and its solution nodes, and the verify/coverage gate treats them as in-scope. The `prefer-structural-fix` law no longer makes them optional — it requires serialization of the whole durable sequence and justifies the coordinator by amortization + batching. The transparent direct path is additionally serialized by the extended flock (evaluate-fix-ladder option a).
